lines: That was idle talk, and I would know.
I have seen wrong turns with more sense than that.
Careful. Even time looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken watching with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You make idleness look productive.
I have waited around with more purpose than that.
That idea is unemployed for good reason.
Your manners need a job and supervision.
Even an empty workstation seems more prepared.
You bring less use than a broken broom.
I would assign that opinion to compost duty.
A spare bucket has clearer ambitions.
Your confidence is available because nobody hired it.
That remark arrived late and underqualified.
You make standing around look demanding.
I could find work before finding sense in that.
A vacant stall has more promise.
You are the reason help wanted signs look nervous.
That thought should keep looking for placement.
